title: From GenAI Virtual Patient Dialogue Logs to Teacher-Interpretable Process Evidence: A Learning Analytics Study in Higher Education
abstract: arXiv:2608.28619v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Medical history taking is a dialogue-based clinical reasoning task in which learners must gather, organise, and integrate patient information while the consultation unfolds. Generative AI-powered virtual patients (GenAI VPs) make repeated history taking practice scalable and preserve full turn by turn dialogue. However, these logs are educationally difficult to use directly. Complete transcripts are too detailed for routine teacher review, whereas final scores obscure whether learners followed up patient cues, checked uncertainty, or used summaries to guide later questioning. This study examined whether coded GenAI VP dialogues can provide teacher-interpretable process evidence of clinical reasoning. We analysed 1{,}030 GenAI VP dialogues from 210 second-year medical learners across five weeks chest-pain cases. translated_title: 从生成式AI虚拟病人对话记录到教师可解读的过程性证据：一项高等教育学习分析研究
translated_abstract: 医学问诊是一项基于对话的临床推理任务，学习者需要在问诊进行的同时收集、组织和整合病人信息。基于生成式AI的虚拟病人使反复的问诊练习得以规模化，并完整保留逐轮对话记录。然而，这些记录在教育上难以直接使用：完整的对话转录对于教师的日常审阅来说过于冗长细致，而最终评分则掩盖了学习者是否跟进病人提供的线索、是否核查不确定性、或是否运用总结来指导后续提问等过程信息。本研究探讨了经过编码的生成式AI虚拟病人对话能否为临床推理提供教师可解读的过程性证据。我们分析了210名二年级医学学习者在为期五周的胸痛病例中的1,030个生成式AI虚拟病人对话。每次问诊由教师使用评估完整问诊对话的评分量表进行评分，问诊过程被分类……
tldr: 本研究分析了210名医学生在胸痛病例中的1,030个生成式AI虚拟病人对话记录，证明经过编码的对话过程数据能够为教师提供可解读的临床推理过程性证据，解决了完整转录过于冗长而最终评分又掩盖学习过程细节的难题。
en_tdlr: By analyzing 1,030 GenAI virtual patient dialogues from 210 medical learners across five weeks of chest-pain cases, this study demonstrates that coded dialogue logs can provide teacher-interpretable process evidence of clinical reasoning, bridging the gap between overly detailed transcripts and final scores that obscure learners' follow-up of patient cues, uncertainty checking, and use of summaries.
